stages.title: Records corridor
stages.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production side-scrolling runner game background, scene 1 of a cohesive four-scene world. Create an original endless Austrian tax-office records corridor at night, with repeating tall filing cabinets, orderly dossier shelves, institutional doors without labels, and a rhythmic line of fluorescent ceiling lights. Empty government records corridor after hours; deep perspective kept mostly perpendicular to the runner lane, with architecture designed to tile plausibly through alternating mirrored horizontal scrolling. Premium professional stylized 2.5D game environment illustration, painterly 3D-like forms, not photorealistic; cohesive with a charming polished cartoon runner game while keeping foreground sprites highly readable. Very wide cinematic 16:9 or ultrawide landscape. Side-on camera, nearly perpendicular elevation with only gentle depth. An uninterrupted, level, dark floor/ground line at the lower fifth. Keep the full lower running lane clear from edge to edge; all cabinets and fixtures behind it. Layer detail in midground/background. No giant foreground object. Moody blue and teal night palette, cold fluorescent ceiling rhythm, a few small isolated warm utility lights, controlled contrast, calm uncanny after-hours atmosphere. No people, animals, characters, silhouettes, logos, readable text, letters, numbers, signs, gibberish, or watermarks. No obstacles blocking the lower running lane. Stable ground geometry and readable at mobile size. No fire, smoke, destruction, Vienna landmarks, or copied existing assets. Avoid photorealism, fisheye, extreme vanishing point, tilted floor, foreground clutter, illegible paperwork text, visual noise.

stages.title: Caseworker corridor
stages.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: high-quality raster side-scrolling game background
Primary request: Create one original late-night Austrian tax-office caseworker corridor, visually coherent with an existing set of moody Finanzamt game environments yet clearly distinct from a records corridor, an open-plan office, and an archive basement.
Scene/backdrop: A long administrative corridor lined with glass-partitioned individual caseworker office rooms. Through the glass, show unoccupied desks, modest office chairs, stacks of folders, loose paperwork, filing trays, and restrained Austrian public-office interior details without flags, emblems, branding, or signage. Beyond or behind the rooms, include dark exterior windows streaked with rain and a subtle distant night-city presence.
Subject: The empty corridor environment itself; no people or characters.
Style/medium: polished stylized 2.5D game-environment concept art, painterly-realistic surfaces, crisp controlled shapes, coherent architectural perspective, production-ready background art; match the visual language of dark blue institutional interiors with selective warm lamps.
Composition/framing: wide ultrawide landscape, approximately 16:9, camera largely perpendicular to the corridor for a side-on platformer view, stable horizon and only restrained depth into rooms. Preserve an uninterrupted, empty, flat horizontal running lane across the full width near the lower fifth of the frame. Architectural rhythm should come from alternating glass office bays, mullions, doors, and glimpses of desks, not from large foreground props. Keep all furniture and paperwork behind the glass and out of the lane.
Lighting/mood: very late at night, quiet, bureaucratic, slightly noir and atmospheric. Cool blue/teal ambient night light dominates; a few isolated warm amber desk lamps glow behind glass, creating soft reflections on partitions and the polished corridor floor. Rain trails on dark windows catch subtle blue highlights.
Color palette: deep navy, slate blue, muted teal, charcoal, desaturated gray, with controlled warm amber pools from desk lamps.
Materials/textures: rain-streaked glass, subtle condensation and reflections, painted metal mullions, institutional floor tile, veneered desks, paper and cardboard folders; detailed but uncluttered.
Text: none.
Constraints: one continuous coherent location; readable side-scrolling silhouette; lane remains empty and stable; no people, no characters, no logos, no readable text, no signs, no watermarks, no gibberish; no large foreground object blocking the lane; no dramatic vanishing-point camera; no close-up furniture; no excessive fisheye distortion.
Avoid: duplicating the prior scenes' filing-cabinet wall, open-plan cubicle field, or industrial archive shelving; avoid daylight, crowds, fantasy elements, neon cyberpunk styling, photoreal camera grain, interface overlays, captions, borders, or letters.
